Features.title: Money
Features.lead: Your relationship with money, clarified — not just "more money".
Features.body: Many financial blocks don't come from a lack of strategy, but from an unconscious relationship with money that's never been questioned. We start by working on what you actually believe, before setting a concrete, measurable intention.

Features.title: Love
Features.lead: Becoming the version of you that makes the relationship possible.
Features.body: Manifesting in love doesn't mean attracting one specific person — it means identifying the pattern that's still keeping that relationship from happening, and defusing it, instead of focusing solely on the other person.

Features.title: Career
Features.lead: A clear definition of what you're really looking for.
Features.body: The block rarely comes from a lack of skill — it comes from a fuzzy ambition: status, freedom, impact, or security. We help you name precisely what "success" means for you, without other people's gaze.

Features.title: Confidence
Features.lead: Built through proof, not repetition alone.
Features.body: Every promise you keep to yourself reinforces internal proof; every promise you break reinforces the opposite. Confidence is built through small, chosen, concrete proof — not through affirmations repeated into thin air.

Features.title: Body & Health
Features.lead: Listening to your body, not just disciplining it.
Features.body: This area often escapes manifestation altogether, reduced to sheer discipline. Yet your relationship with your body — gratitude or frustration — always precedes the physical result you're after.

Features.title: Creativity
Features.lead: Recreating the space where inspiration returns.
Features.body: Creativity is almost never missing because of a lack of ideas, but because of a lack of space, time, silence, and permission to create without judging. We work on the conditions, not on forcing it.

Features.title: Lifestyle
Features.lead: A daily life aligned with the life you're aiming for.
Features.body: This is the most often neglected area, yet a poorly aligned lifestyle drains the energy needed to move forward in every other area. Here, we examine your actual days, not the ones you dream about.

Features.title: Spirituality
Features.lead: A stable inner space, with no dogma imposed.
Features.body: No religious framework needed — just one simple question: what are you connected to. This area isn't about obtaining something, but about cultivating an inner space stable enough for everything else to anchor into.
